reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 30 foil sachets for $29.99, which is a dollar a day, and zero reviews. I reorder one bottle I already trust, and I won't try something with no reviews when I can't read the 1-star complaints about stomach or fake dosing.
objection: No reviews at all, so I can't check what people say about stomach upset or whether the dose is real. And individual foil packets are wasteful, plus I'm paying for packaging, not magnesium. A bottle of bisglycinate costs me a lot less per serving.
would_change_my_mind: Several hundred reviews with a decent 1-star section, and a price closer to $15 to $18 for 30 servings.
